articles.title: NFL today: How to watch Buccaneers v Cowboys, TV channels & live stream Thursday 8 October
articles.summary: How will the Buccaneers and Cowboys fare today? Here is what to know, including kick-off time, TV channels and live stream options. The bad news for the Buccaneers: Their 0-4 start has been an unmitigated disaster that, in normal circumstances, would have already evaporated their playoff chances.
body: If the Bucs want to join the 1992 Chargers and become the second team to make the postseason after an 0-4 opening, they’ll need to stop the bleeding on Thursday night in north Texas. They’ll have to do it without Baker Mayfield, who continues to nurse an injury to his throwing thumb.

They’ll face a challenge against the Cowboys, who are just 2-2 but look like slim favorites in the NFC East while the Eagles struggle to get out of neutral. The Cowboys have gotten an excellent first four games from Dak Prescott, who has paced one of the most efficient offenses in football. No team is scoring more than Dallas’ 3.4 points per offensive series, and it’s been Prescott and the passing game doing most of that work. (Nearly 75%t of Dallas’ yards have come through the air, compared to a league average of two-thirds.) A big outing against Tampa Bay would solidify the Cowboys’ path to a division title.
United Kingdom: Watch on Sky Sports NFL or Sky Sports Main Event, or stream with NOW or NFL Game Pass on DAZN.

articles.title: Glasner urges quick end to Manchester City saga and fears damage to Premier League
articles.summary: Forest manager believes football fans may ‘switch off’ ‘The most important thing is the integrity of the league’ Oliver Glasner has said Manchester City being found guilty of arranging “sham contracts” has damaged the Premier League brand globally and believes the integrity of the English top…
body: The Nottingham Forest head coach said the league faces a job to repair its image and suggested supporters might switch off after City were found to have artificially inflated their income by more than £900m.

City have appealed against last week’s seismic judgment of an independent commission that they broke financial rules across a nine-year period. If City’s appeal fails, the panel could determine a range of sporting sanctions, including expulsion from the league and point deductions. Glasner said the case must be finalised “as soon as possible” to protect the competition’s integrity.

Glasner cited his experience of Crystal Palace being demoted from the Europa League at the court of arbitration for sport (Cas) last year for breaking Uefa’s multi-club ownership rules as an example of how legal processes can drag.

“Let’s wait until the final verdict is spoken, but my wish is just that this is quick,” Glasner said. “Because we didn’t know with Palace if we were in the Europa League or Conference League and then it was ‘you will hear on Thursday’ and then that became Monday, because it was always delayed. Then we got the final verdict 10 days before the Conference League started.

articles.title: Suspended fine for Xhaka over Covid-19 certificate
articles.summary: Sunderland captain Granit Xhaka says he has received a suspended fine of 150,000 Swiss francs (£136,000) for obtaining a forged Covid-19 vaccination certificate.
body: The 34-year-old, who is alleged to have obtained the certificate in 2022 when it was a requirement in Switzerland for some travel abroad, says the fine is suspended for two years provided he does not commit any further offences, and that he has already paid the court costs.
"A few weeks ago, I spoke personally here and said that I would take responsibility for my decision. I stand by that," the midfielder wrote in German on Instagram.
"I was sentenced by summary judgment for obtaining a false certification to a suspended fine of 50 daily rates of CHF 3,000 [£2,726] each.
"I accept the decision and take responsibility for my actions. Thank you for the many messages of support over the past few weeks. They mean a lot to me."

articles.title: Kentucky State basketball player released after two months in ICE custody
articles.summary: Senegalese player Aminata Seck freed on $2,500 bond. Judge finds 26-year-old is not a flight risk or danger. Seck was detained at Louisville airport in August. A Kentucky State University women’s basketball player from Senegal who was arrested by Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) has been…
body: At a hearing on Tuesday, a judge granted Aminata Seck a $2,500 bond, which was posted on Wednesday after ICE did not appeal, according to Hishem Alsalman, managing attorney at Alsalman Law Office.
The judge found that Seck was neither a danger to the community nor a flight risk, Alsalman said on Thursday.
The judge also ruled that she could continue working towards her degree and praised her academic and athletic achievements.
Seck, 26, was detained on 7 August at Louisville Muhammad Ali International Airport as she was preparing to travel with her team to a tournament.

articles.title: Wiegman praises Toone’s attitude after late Lionesses recall for Greece playoff
articles.summary: Manchester United midfielder was left out of initial squad. First leg of World Cup playoff is on Friday in Crete. Sarina Wiegman heaped praise on Ella Toone for her positive reaction to being left out of England’s initial squad for their Women’s World Cup playoff against Greece, after recalling the…
body: An injury sustained by Lucy Bronze, described by Wiegman as “really small”, prompted the England right-back to return to Chelsea and Wiegman called up Toone, who travelled to Greece on Friday from Spain, where she had organised a training routine during the international window.

Toone has 69 caps and has scored 24 goals, including in the Euro 2022 final and 2023 World Cup semi-final, but Wiegman said when naming her squad that she had left out Toone and Chloe Kelly because “the levels weren’t what I expect from them on the pitch”. On Saturday, after starting Manchester United’s victory over Liverpool, Toone took ownership of things, telling the BBC: “It’s about me now. I’ve got to keep working hard and use it as fuel to come back even better.”

Wiegman, asked whether she had been impressed with Toone’s response, said: “Yes, very much. I think when I gave her the call, of course that was a hard call. But she took that straight away. Of course [she was] very disappointed, but the first thing she did [was say]: ‘OK, I’m going to get back, I’m going to do that.’ She has the support around her too.”

articles.title: Maresca says 'feeling is fantastic' among Man City squad
articles.summary: Manchester City head coach Enzo Maresca says the "feeling is fantastic" among his players and that they "don't care too much about the noise" surrounding the club after it was found guilty of the majority of the 115 charges brought against them by the Premier League.
body: The club's international players returned to training on Thursday, nine days after the Premier League published a damning report that stated the club had used "sham" contracts to disguise secret funding of more than £830m.

BBC Sport reported this week that Maresca would address the players upon their return to domestic duty after news of the verdicts broke while the majority of the squad were away with their respective nations.

It is understood the City head coach asked his players not to allow the crisis that has engulfed the club to affect their attitude and focus as the Premier League campaign gets back under way this weekend.

Speaking to Sky Sports before Sunday's trip to Liverpool, striker Erling Haaland echoed his manager's sentiments, saying: "I care a lot about this place. I spent my first four years here, it's a special place for us. I care a lot about City and the fans. I am a fan myself. I feel with them.

articles.title: Fantasy Football Kicker Streamers: The 3 best pickups for Week 5
articles.summary: Kickers are creatures of game script. In fantasy football that doesn’t make them any different than a lot of running backs and wideouts and tight ends. For those positions, as with kicker, opportunity evaporates with unfriendly game script.
body: The receiver or tight end sees a dip in routes and targets when their team gets out to a big lead and runs the rock in the second half. The running back ends up with ten carries instead of twenty because his team has to abandon the run as they chase points in a trailing script. In an opportunity-based game, this is something short of ideal.

That’s why we want kickers in our lineups whose teams have a good chance of seeing plenty of neutral or positive game script. Usually this means a team won’t forgo easy field goal opportunities in the second half, down by multiple scores. So there is a process to selecting kickers -- even those off the waiver wire.

In this space I’ll highlight a few waiver kicker options who check the boxes of a viable play. Some, of course, will be better than others. Oh, and one more thing: Accuracy doesn’t really matter at all. We want opportunity.

Below is a look at kicker fantasy production allowed by each team through Week 4, along with a graph showing which coaches are most aggressive and most conservative with their fourth down decision making.

articles.title: Floored by Farrell to top of the league - Atkinson on Gloucester resurgence
articles.summary: Charlie Atkinson has had three professional clubs and plenty of set-backs in his career so far, but now he is riding high with a resurgent Gloucester
body: Atkinson had just come off the bench against Saracens when, having fielded a kick downfield, he was blindsided by Owen Farrell's reckless, high tackle. Atkinson was left unconscious on the Stonex pitch as the referee showed red.
Farrell was instantly contrite, waiting on the touchline to check on Atkinson and then visiting him again in the dressing room.

"It was obviously accidental, but as it was a concussion I was sent home for the week, I didn't play again that season. It was probably a good thing, slowing down so that at 18, I could just focus on training and getting used to men's rugby."
Atkinson is good at seeing the upside. He has had to be. Perspective comes with experience and he has been through plenty already in his rugby career.

articles.title: Celtics' Jayson Tatum Lands at No. 13 in Player Rankings for 'Wildcard' Reason
articles.summary: 13 in Player Rankings for 'Wildcard' Reason originally appeared on NESN. Add NESN as a Preferred Source by clicking here. Ahead of the 2026-27 season, ESPN ranked Jayson Tatum as the NBA's ninth-best player. The Sporting News' Steph Noh isn't quite as high on the Boston Celtics star.
body: Noh has Tatum ranked No. 13 in his rankings of NBA starters, putting him between the Houston Rockets' Kevin Durant (12) and the Indiana Pacers' Tyrese Haliburton (14).
Tatum isn't the only star Noh took a cautious approach with. He called Tatum, Haliburton, Anthony Davis and Joel Embiid "wildcards" because of the uncertainty surrounding their health.

"Tatum looked like 80 percent of himself in his brief stint last year," Noh wrote. "Embiid's defense looks like it will never be back at its elite level, but he's still a good enough offensive player to be in the top 25. Davis could have a huge year playing next to an elite lob thrower in Trae Young. And Haliburton is the biggest question mark after missing an entire season with his Achilles and shingles issues. His passing should immediately return. The conditioning and shooting touch may take longer."
Interestingly, Noh's assessment lines up closely with Tatum's own evaluation of his health last season.

articles.title: Hunter Bell celebrates in Team GB's 'glam' female track success
articles.summary: Georgia Hunter Bell has enjoyed quite the year, winning a hat-trick of gold medals at the World Indoor Championships, for England at the Commonwealth Games, and again for Team GB at the European Championships.
body: But British female track success in 2025 certainly didn't stop there. Sprinter Amy Hunt made headlines with a record four-gold display in the Europeans in Birmingham, while Dina Asher-Smith now tops the all-time medal table at the championships after winning her 11th, eight of which are gold.

Among other successes, Keely Hodgkinson claimed World Indoor gold in the 800m in March - in the second-fastest indoor time in history - and set a new British record at that distance in the summer, though she'd be pipped to gold at the Europeans after sitting out the Commonwealth Games due to muscle tightness.
"It's really cool. just being part of this era. It's really fun," Hunter Bell told Sky Sports.
"We all know each other very well. We all travel together, see each other a lot throughout the year, so it's fun to tune in and be like, 'Oh, Amy's racing tonight'.

articles.title: Austin Riley’s Slump Threatens Braves Core Stability
articles.summary: The 2026 Atlanta Braves season ended on a sour note Wednesday. A 4-1 loss to the Los Angeles Dodgers in Game 4 of the NLDS officially knocked the team out of the postseason. It is hard to swallow that a 94-win season and an NL East title ended like this.
body: Since the 2021 World Series win, the team has struggled to find postseason success. According to CBS Sports, the franchise has only won one playoff series since that title, which was this year’s Wild Card Series. The team has a 5-12 record in the playoffs since that championship. While the club added 18 wins to their total from last year, the early exit leaves a lot of questions for the front office.

The biggest worry for the future involves the middle of the lineup. Austin Riley is signed through 2032, but his recent numbers look scary. Between 2021 and 2023, he was a top 10 finisher in the NL MVP race for three straight years. Now, the production is disappearing. CBS Sports reported that his OPS+ dropped to 115 in 2024 and 105 in 2025. This past season, that number cratered to 80, which is 20% worse than the league average.

It isn’t just bad luck, either. His strikeout and whiff rates are climbing. If the third baseman keeps sliding down this path, the long-term contract becomes a massive burden. We need the old Riley back to keep this window open.

Friday's opening round will see 16 matches take place across the day and then the top 16 players on the PDC Werner Rankings Ladder will enter the tournament in round two on Saturday, as top seed Humphries begins his challenge against Kevin Doets or Nick Kenny.

Following the conclusion of Saturday's action, the last 16 will return to the stage on Sunday and the tournament then concludes with the quarter-finals, semi-finals and final in a blockbuster evening session.

articles.title: 'It's about time!' - F1 drivers excited amid Rwanda GP rumours
articles.summary: Lewis Hamilton, Max Verstappen and George Russell have expressed their excitement at the possibility of Rwanda hosting a Formula 1 race amid speculation the African nation could soon be added to the sport's calendar.
body: With Africa not having hosted an F1 race since the 1993 South African Grand Prix, Hamilton has been pushing hard over the last few years for the continent to return to the F1 schedule.
Several reports on Thursday claim an agreement has been struck and that an announcement could be made as soon as next week to confirm Rwanda's addition to the calendar for the 2030 season.

Asked about the speculation ahead of this weekend's Singapore Grand Prix, Hamilton said: "I haven't really got any news for you. I saw something on people posting online, but I've always said that we need to have a Grand Prix in Africa.
"It is, for me, the most important continent, to be honest, the most beautiful continent. We're on all the other continents but that one and there should be no reason for it."
